Messages.Author: James B. Floate
Messages.Body:
Hey peoples,
LSJ, one final question on Rutor's Hand, if the damage is treated like
a 'strike in combat' can you use Meril Molitor's ability to change it to
normal?
Some of my group was unhappy with this, and its nice to run around with
official clout.
Thanks,
James.
